estilo: Documentary photo, soft natural daylight, Brazilian home garden, realistic colors, sharp focus, no text, no logos

A very short epiphyllum cutting of a flat leaf-like stem in a small pot, only green and with no flowers
Agave mother rosette surrounded by several small pups in a garden bed; the small mascot figurine stands on the soil beside the biggest pup
Echeveria agavoides forming a dense clump of many small rosettes in a clay pot
A gladiolus corm lifted from the soil with many small cormlets attached around it
Caladium with colorful red and white leaves sprouting in a pot
